name: Vibes
subtitle: Downloads for Vibes, a music player for Navidrome.

apps.name: Vibes
apps.subtitle: A music player for Navidrome.
apps.localizedDescription: Vibes plays your music from a Navidrome server: playlists, downloads for offline, Smart Shuffle, a DJ, lyrics, listening stats, and playing on speakers and TVs. You need an account on a Navidrome server to use it.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to connect to your Navidrome server, and to find and play on speakers and TVs on your Wi-Fi.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vibes uses a photo you pick as a playlist's cover.
